remarks: Suitable for May 1, 2026 occupancy! Recently renovated, three-bedroom 1st floor apartment (6 steps) at 274 Valley Road offers a modern, clean & practical layout. The main level opens into a bright kitchen and living area with updated appliances, a gas range, and an impressive island! Sliding doors lead to a Juliet balcony.  The main floor includes three bedrooms and two remodeled full bathrooms, along with hardwood flooring throughout. The lower level adds useful extra space, featuring a large tiled room and an additional full bath-well suited for a home office, recreation area, or storage. This level also connects to a shared laundry area, where the unit has its own designated washer and dryer (left side).  Located within a multi-family property, the apartment includes two assigned off-street parking spaces and is close to local shops, transit, and Cos Cob's waterfront. Super friendly landlord lives onsite. 670+ credit score, and at least 3x monthly rent in collective earnings! No pets- sorry! Schedule your tour today!
